summary: The diff is a single, purely additive 206-line registries entry appended to ai-os/MASTER_INDEX.yaml documenting a fresh Vercel+GitHub infrastructure census (3 Vercel projects, 7 GitHub repos, PR states); it contains no deletions, no code, no .github/workflows/** changes, and no migration/schema/auth/permission/billing/rls path matches, consistent with its tier1 pre-classification. I verified the full file still parses as valid YAML after the change (no stray merge-conflict markers or structural breakage), confirming the PR85 conflict was resolved cleanly by appending after existing content rather than corrupting the file. The entry only records environment-variable key names (never values, as explicitly stated in the entry itself) alongside Vercel project/team IDs and GitHub PR/repo metadata, none of which constitute secrets, and it follows the same id/type/path/scope/status shape as neighboring registries entries. The content is self-citing (explicit verification commands, timestamps, and a discrepancies-vs-known-context section noting PR #84 was already merged), which is good audit hygiene for a documentation-only change.
